title: PictoAccess: accessibility of places, mostly in France
description: Accessibility of about 1,700 places, mostly in France: transport stops, offices, shops, hotels, culture and sports venues, town halls, and university and hospital buildings. Each place has a level per disability type (wheelchair users, walking difficulty, cognitive, blind, low vision, deaf, hard of hearing, temporary reduced mobility): autonomous, with help, inaccessible or unknown. Many places have a questionnaire per area (entrance, reception, toilets, ...). Places are grouped by organisation or site (a university, a campus, a transport network), and related buildings can be retrieved. Texts are in French. Snapshot of a full export provided by PictoAccess.
licence_note: Export provided directly by PictoAccess (APF France Handicap) for this demonstrator, used until their API is available again; reuse terms beyond the demonstrator not yet confirmed. An open subset (scores per disability type) is published daily on data.gouv.fr under ODbL.

assessment.note: Places are assessed with PictoAccess's self-diagnosis tool ('outil d'auto-diagnostic'), usually by the owner or the local authority; users can add opinions. The assessment date is accessibility.updated_at in place details.
